decisions.reason: Because this yogurt closely extends the firm's established dairy know-how and already shows external validation through an award, management would expect it to be easy to refine and commercially exploit rather than withdraw.
As a cheese variant squarely based on existing capabilities and highlighted on the home page as a strategic focus product, it fits the firm's knowledge base and direction, so withdrawal is unlikely.
This semi-hard cheese wheel is very close to the firm's core cheese competence, so absorptive capacity is high, but its lower prominence gives it a somewhat higher risk than the flagship products.

A spicy cheese line builds directly on established cheese-making and flavor-extension capabilities, and having several models suggests enough commitment and learning potential to keep it on the market.
The mild creamy soft cheese extends the existing cheese portfolio in a familiar direction, and the firm should be able to interpret market feedback and improve it without major new knowledge gaps.

Although washed-rind soft cheese is still related to the firm's cheese expertise, it is likely a bit more demanding in market acceptance and process control, so it carries the highest but still minority withdrawal risk.
